answer: Per-identity bonds stop Sybils by making each fake account escrow a scarce outside asset. One account costs little to fake, but a thousand paying identities must lock a thousand bonds, and a single proof linking the cluster slashes all of them at once while the reward only reaches accounts verified as distinct. I size the bond so one separated Sybil must earn more than its whole escrow; the prism of duplicate accounts splits, the bond does not, and nectar from the meadow pays only those who truly stand apart.
